title: Tony Hawk's Downhill Jam
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

Downhill racing with tricks: tricks fill the boost meter, boost wins races
Events include races and target-shooting challenges (stand on a point and destroy all targets)

Tricks fill the boost meter
Perfect landings and balance keep your speed; crashing loses the combo and time

Race rivals downhill; tricks give speed

rows: stop at the marker and aim with the d-pad at each target
